_comment: TEST FIXTURES. Hand-written readings of the seeded demo events, used to
exercise the matching and scoring code offline without API calls.
Each one contains only what the article text supports -- the same constraint
the real extractor works under. Rows produced from these are tagged
extractor='fixture' in platform.event_impacts so a fixture run can never be
passed off as a model run.

EVT-2026-09-02-001.mechanism: Shipments departing on or after the effective date require an export licence, and licence processing is expected to run four to eight weeks behind.
EVT-2026-09-02-001.reasoning: The notice imposes a licensing requirement on microcontroller exports from China with a stated effective date. It explicitly warns that booked but uncleared shipments may be held.

EVT-2026-09-01-014.mechanism: Container handling was suspended for 36 hours, leaving a backlog that delays outbound shipments from the port.
EVT-2026-09-01-014.reasoning: A weather event physically halted port operations. No component category is named, so this affects whatever happens to ship through Kaohsiung rather than a specific part type.

EVT-2026-08-29-007.mechanism: Higher copper input costs are expected to raise prices on wiring, connectors and magnetics over the next two quarters.
EVT-2026-08-29-007.reasoning: This is a commodity price movement, not an interruption to physical supply. Nothing in the article suggests parts will fail to arrive.

EVT-2026-08-30-002.mechanism: A fire has halted production at an MLCC plant, and buyers are being put on allocation for small case size parts.
EVT-2026-08-30-002.reasoning: Production has physically stopped at a named category of plant with no restart date given. The article gives no basis for a delay figure, so none is reported.

EVT-2026-08-27-019.mechanism: A duty rate change would raise landed cost, but only after a 90 day consultation and not before the following fiscal year.
EVT-2026-08-27-019.reasoning: This is a consultation, not a decision, and any effect is a cost change rather than a supply interruption. Nothing takes effect inside a planning horizon measured in weeks.

EVT-2026-08-31-011.mechanism: Wafer allocation moving to higher margin lines has pushed quoted lead times on automotive qualified microcontrollers back towards 20 weeks.
EVT-2026-08-31-011.reasoning: Lead times lengthening is a genuine supply constraint, but the article names no country and no specific supplier. It concerns automotive qualified parts specifically.

EVT-2026-08-20-033.mechanism: None. This describes end market demand for finished consumer devices.
EVT-2026-08-20-033.reasoning: Smartphone shipment figures say nothing about our ability to obtain components. This is market news, not a supply event.
